top_signals.title: Rayner warns Reform’s £72m crypto windfall could be caught by new donor rules
top_signals.summary: Angela Rayner has warned Reform UK that its record £72m fundraising haul from two cryptocurrency billionaires could be caught by retrospective rules being pushed through parliament. The housing secretary said new restrictions on political donations from Britons living abroad, or those who have recently returned to the UK, would be backdated as ministers seek to [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
top_signals.summary: The House is scheduled to be sent home in the coming days until after November's midterm elections, leaving a narrow window to pass any form of AI regulation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
